div.p: This case-sensitive code system http://example.org/fhir/eu-ai-transparency/CodeSystem/eu-ai-clinical-validation-status-cs defines the following codes:

tr.td: Clinical validation for the documented intended use has been completed.
Clinical validation for the documented intended use has not been completed.
Clinical validation is ongoing and no final validation conclusion has yet been documented.
Technical verification or validation has been performed, but clinical validation for the intended use has not been completed.

title.value: EU AI Clinical Validation Status Code System

description.value: Codes indicating the documented clinical validation status of an AI system for its intended clinical use.
